title: Trusted selective scene retry and review handoff
description: Complete the primary Scene Review checkpoint by regenerating only the selected scene through the main-process orchestrator and preserving a truthful manual CapCut handoff before packaging.
businessContext: The simplified flow currently exposes a scene review screen but selective retry is unimplemented and final orchestration fabricates CapCut approval.
dependencies: approved asset acquisition and asset review
acceptanceCriteria: Retrying a scene invokes a trusted main-process route scoped to that scene and does not rerun unrelated scene media.
Selective retry preserves unchanged approved scene assets and invalidates only asset review and downstream media artifacts.
Scene Review exposes a usable retry action and a truthful review handoff without raw IPC errors.
Final orchestration never submits the historical CapCut confirmation string automatically; packaging waits for explicit CapCut review.
Focused orchestrator/schema checks, typecheck, and diff check pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/productionOrchestrator.test.ts packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: Selective media regeneration requires a new provider or persistence system.
